name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door frame and a knock-down frame?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door frame and a knock-down frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door frame comes as a complete unit with the door already installed in the frame, including hinges and often the bore for the doorknob. This option simplifies installation as it's designed to fit directly into a prepared rough opening. A knock-down frame, also known as a slab door frame kit, comes as separate pieces that need to be assembled on-site before the door slab is hung. Pre-hung units are generally faster to install, while knock-down frames offer more flexibility for custom sizing or specific door hardware.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-hung frame includes the door and frame as a complete unit for easier installation, while a knock-down frame comes in pieces for assembly on-site.
